newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Plutonic posts record quarter gold output.
newsitem.headline: Plutonic posts record quarter gold output.

text.p: Gold miner Plutonic Resources Ltd said on Tuesday its gold production rose to a record 138,231 ounces in the quarter ended June 30 from 121,922 in the March quarter, while cash operating costs fell sharply.

However, the poor performance of the gold market and a decline in hedging prospects had led the company to review its operations, while orebody development has been suspended at its Mt Morgans mine, Plutonic said in its quarterly report.
"The company does not believe that it is appropriate to dissipate the value of its hedging gains by subsidising unprofitable, high cost mines on a long-term basis," it said.
Plutonic had 904,890 ounces of gold sold forward at an average A$531 an ounce at June 30, compared with the June quarter average spot price of A$452 an ounce.
The cash cost of production for the June quarter was A$348 an ounce, down A$55 on the preceding quarter.
Plutonic produced 115,243 ounces in the June quarter last year at A$371 an ounce.
The lower cash cost reflected a rise in production at the Plutonic mine, and higher grades and production at the Darlot and Lawlers mines, the company said.
The Plutonic mine produced 73,938 ounces at a cash operating cost of A$292 an ounce, its second best quarterly performance.
However, cash costs rose to A$576 an ounce at its 80 percent owned Mt Morgans mine and Plutonic said all orebody development would be suspended from July 31.
All capital expenditure had also been curtailed at the mine, which produced a total of 20,619 ounces in the June quarter, and a proposed new tailings dam had been deferred indefinitely.

"The remaining tailings capacity will be exhausted by about January 1998 at which time, in the absence of exploration success or sharply improved operational performance, the mine may be placed in care and maintenance," Plutonic said.
The joint venture had approved a A$2 million exploration budget for the second half of 1997 at the mine, it said.
The miner is 32.9 percent owned by Malaysia Mining Corp Bhd.
